[autotest] Add a --dry-run option to deployment. This replaces the --noinstall and --nostable options in deployment_test and repair_test with a single --dry-run option. The changes to the logic around the options also now mean that failures in 'chromeos-install' are distinguished from failures in 'chromeos-firmwareupdate'. kvm: fix fetching irqchip state for PICs other than the first one The KVM API to fetch interrupt controller state expects caller to supply number (id) of the interrupt controller number in which state the caller is interested. To allow crosvm to fetch the correct state and to improve type safety we split the API into one that handles the PIC (primary and secondary) and the one that handles IOAPIC. BUG=b:76083711 TEST=cargo test -p kvm Change-Id: Ia45b51cb218072a275c244af2de1b4a73a1d3352 Signed-off-by: Dmitry Torokhov <dtor@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/986510 Reviewed-by: Zach Reizner <zachr@chromium.org>

plugin: allow retrieving and setting VM and VCPU states This change allows plugin to retrieve and set various VM and VCPU states: interrupt controller, PIT, LAPIC and MP state. camera: Don't transmit the image back in QR code mode. Since the QR code mode doesn't change the image captured, we don't need to transmit the image back to UI. This speed up the QR code mode e2e test a bit. BUG=none TEST=make test TEST=manually on DUT, test that both e2e QR and face mode works. Change-Id: Ie4b1842af8a62d4d99abf6fce00dafa86e016151 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/985342 Commit-Ready: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Tested-by: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Youcheng Syu <youcheng@chromium.org>

camera: Send image back through Goofy RPC instead of event. Since the event server does broadcast on all data received, and has an upper limit on the size of each message, it's not suitable for passing large blob. Change how the image is sent back to pytest to using goofy_rpc to put the content to a temporary file. This speed up the transmitting time for each frame from 0.2 seconds to 0.1 seconds in my testing. BUG=None TEST=make test TEST=manually on DUT. Change-Id: Ia05df2e60a1cc0b794f89a81d6bbe0166a6a829e Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/986113 Commit-Ready: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Tested-by: Pi-Hsun Shih <pihsun@chromium.org> Tested-by: Youcheng Syu <youcheng@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Youcheng Syu <youcheng@chromium.org>
